privacy:
Last updated: September 2026
[H2] Information We Collect
When you visit our website, use Find My System, or schedule a consultation or installation, we collect the information needed to respond to you and complete the work: your name, phone number, email address, city and ZIP code, details about your water and household you choose to share, and basic information about your device and how you use the site (including the page you arrived on and any campaign parameters in the link you clicked).
[H2] How We Use Your Information
We use the information we collect to:
- Respond to your request and recommend the right system
- Schedule, confirm, remind you about, and complete your consultation or installation
- Communicate with you about appointments, systems, quotes, warranty and support
- Screen requests for potential fraud or abuse
- Understand and improve our website and marketing
[H2] Text Messages
If you check the box agreeing to receive text messages, we may send appointment confirmations, reminders and follow-ups about your request by SMS. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. Reply STOP to opt out at any time or HELP for help. Consent to receive texts is not a condition of purchase.
[H2] Sharing Your Information
Your information is stored in our customer relationship management system and shared only with the service providers that help us run the business, such as our CRM, scheduling and analytics providers, and installation scheduling tools. We do not sell your personal information.
[H2] Your Privacy Rights
Our services are offered within the State of Minnesota. You have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, to request that it be corrected or deleted, and to opt out of marketing communications. To exercise any of these rights, email info@msppurewaterco.com or call or text (952) 952-6206.
[H2] Cookies and Analytics
We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences (for example, the water source you selected) and to measure which pages and campaigns lead to requests. You can clear or block cookies in your browser settings.
[H2] Contact
Questions about this policy: info@msppurewaterco.com or (952) 952-6206.

Last updated: September 2026
[H2] Overview
This website is operated by MSP Pure Water. Throughout the site, the terms “we”, “us” and “our” refer to MSP Pure Water. By using this site or scheduling a consultation you agree to these terms.
[H2] Consultations and Scheduling
Booking a consultation online reserves an appointment window; no deposit is required. We will confirm the appointment by phone, text or email. You may reschedule or cancel using the link in your confirmation or by contacting us.
[H2] Pricing
System prices published on this site are installed prices for standard installations in our service area. Final well-water configuration depends on water test results. Financing options are available on request. Travel fees may apply for installations beyond 35 miles from Minneapolis. Prices are subject to change without notice; the price confirmed at your consultation applies to your installation.
[H2] Best Price Guarantee
To claim the Best Price Guarantee, provide a written quote from another company for comparable equipment and installation before your installation is scheduled. We determine whether a quote is comparable in good faith and will explain our reasoning.
[H2] Accuracy of Information
We work to keep the information on this site accurate and current, but equipment specifications and availability can change. Specifications are confirmed at your consultation.
[H2] Warranty and Support
Warranty terms for each system are provided in writing at your consultation and govern over any summary on this site.
[H2] Limitation of Liability
To the fullest extent permitted by law, MSP Pure Water is not liable for indirect or consequential damages arising from use of this website. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under Minnesota law.
[H2] Contact
Questions about these terms: info@msppurewaterco.com or (952) 952-6206.
